title: Full rewrite of county liquor rules
summary: On September 9, commissioners agreed to pause new rule changes until the new rule book is adopted, while the department updates its full rewrite of the liquor rules. An updated draft will return on next month's agenda. Earlier, in July, a special meeting on the comprehensive rule changes was set for August 4 at 9:00.
